audit.whatIsWrong: whys[2], whys[3] and whys[5] were written as Mordekaiser wins while the chart gives those three rows to Ambessa; spikes[2] did the same for the first-item row.
audit.why: Same-page contradiction on four stages. The chart itself was left alone — the ambessa-side audit already resolved that defect in the chart’s favour and aligned its prose the same way.
audit.corrected: whys[2], whys[3], whys[5] and spikes[2].text now state why Ambessa holds those stages, using Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, Repudiation and Lacerate’s 13s.

audit.whatIsWrong: The tracked cooldown was named "Repeating Dashes" — an ability Ambessa does not have — and no timer appeared anywhere.
audit.why: The packet flags that the page never names a single real Ambessa ability. Her passive is Drakehound’s Step, R is Public Execution.
audit.corrected: Every tracked-cooldown surface now names Public Execution at 130s rank 1 and Drakehound’s Step for the dash; Repudiation written as an 18s shield-brace.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two decisive interactions were absent: Repudiation deals increased damage if it blocked non-minion damage while bracing, and Public Execution blinks 1250 to the FARTHEST champion in the chosen line and suppresses on arrival.
audit.why: Riot’s own W and R text state both outright; the page said only "her mobility".
audit.corrected: dontsFull[1].d says never Q into the brace; dontsFull[2].d, report[5].t and breakdown.cooldowns state the 1250 farthest-target blink and the suppress.

edits.after: Q into Sundering Slam plus Lacerate on 13s out-chips your aura ramp, and Drakehound's Step exits before it burns.

edits.after: Weave Drakehound's Step to dodge your slow Obliterate and slip out of the Darkness Rise aura so it never ramps

notes: Not asserted, on purpose: her W and R carry derived "grounding" flags and her R a derived "heal" flag that Riot’s descriptions do not support, so the missingInteractions needs-antiheal headline ("Ambessa sustains through chip damage (Public Execution)") was NOT written to the page — nothing in the R text heals. Mordekaiser’s Q grounding flag is likewise unsupported. breakdown.mid still opens "This is your phase" for levels 3-6 while the chart gives 3 and 4-5 to Ambessa; I left it because level 6 inside that block is genuinely his, but the block is worth a second look.
